title: US Senator Abdul El-Sayed Proposes Military Aid Ban
excerpt: Newly elected US Senator Abdul El-Sayed has stated his intention to stop sending unconditional American weapons and military aid to Pakistan.
body_html:
Newly elected US Senator Abdul El-Sayed has expressed his intention to halt unconditional American military assistance to Pakistan.

According to reports, the newly elected official aims to stop sending American weapons to the country as part of a ban on unconditional military aid.
